items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: That wasn't Lucky Thompson, was it?

ctx.x: Yeah, just coming up, but very good, a very good alto player. Oh, we did a lot of records with him. I can't think of his name.
That wasn't Lucky Thompson, was it?
Oh, no. No, no. No, no. No, he was an alto player, a good alto player, too. Oh, why can't I think of his name?
